log_file.description: Name of the log file (relative to log_dir).

verbose.description: Enable verbose logging (INFO level and above).

rpc_transport_url.description: Messaging transport URL for RPC communication (e.g., RabbitMQ).

auth_strategy.description: Authentication strategy. Use 'keystone' for Keystone-based auth.

report_interval.description: Seconds between agent state reports to Neutron server.

min_broadcast_domain_size.description: Minimum broadcast domain size for L2 agent health checks. Set > 0 only if needed for legacy environments.

l2_population.description: Enable L2 population driver for optimized flooding in tunnel networks (required for DVR).

extension_drivers.description: List of extension drivers to enable (comma-separated string when rendered).

qos_extension_driver.description: Explicit toggle for QoS extension driver (used as fallback if not in extension_drivers list).

port_security_extension_driver.description: Explicit toggle for Port Security extension driver.

trunk_extension_driver.description: Enable trunk extension driver for subport management.

sriov_extension_driver.description: Enable SR-IOV extension driver for bare-metal SR-IOV ports.

security_group_extension_driver.description: Enable security group extension driver (often auto-enabled via extension_drivers).

qos_limit_direction.description: Direction for QoS bandwidth limits (ingress, egress, or both).

bridge_mappings.description: List of network type to OVS bridge mappings (e.g., flat networks → br-ex, VLANs → br-vlan).

ovs_integration_bridge.description: OVS integration bridge name for tenant traffic.

ovs_tunnel_bridge.description: OVS tunnel bridge name for VXLAN/GRE tunnels.

ovs_local_ip.description: Local IP address used for tunnel endpoints (must be reachable by other compute hosts).

ovs_tunnel_types.description: List of tunnel types to use (comma-separated in rendered config).

ovs_vxlan_group.description: Multicast group for VXLAN learning (e.g., '239.1.1.1'). Leave empty to disable (recommended with L2POP).

ovs_arp_responder.description: Enable ARP responder in OVS to respond to ARP requests locally.

ovs_use_centralized_nat.description: Enable centralized NAT (SNAT) for external network access (non-DVR mode).

ovs_dvr_snat_default_br.description: OVS bridge used for SNAT in DVR mode (when centralized NAT is disabled).

securitygroup_log_dropped_traffic.description: Log dropped packets for security group rules.

l3_enable_distributed_routing.description: Enable distributed virtual routing (DVR) support in the agent.

l3_ha_max_agents_per_router.description: Maximum number of L3 agents to schedule per HA router.

l3_l3_ha.description: Enable high-availability mode for L3 services (requires DVR).

l3_min_l3_agents_per_router.description: Minimum number of L3 agents required to keep a router functional.

ml2_type_drivers.description: List of ML2 type drivers enabled (must include types used by bridge_mappings).

ml2_tenant_network_types.description: Network types available for tenant provisioning.

ml2_mechanism_drivers.description: Mechanism drivers that map network types to OVS or other backends.

ml2_extension_drivers.description: Extension drivers for ML2 (same as agent extension_drivers, used in Neutron server).
